summary: First-finish smoke test for MCP Public Portal. Backend auth/courses/batches endpoints work correctly with valid MongoDB SPOC email. Frontend login -> portal flow works, course catalog (4 courses), calendar grid, filters, course detail slide-over, and logout button all render correctly. SSE live updates appear broken (UI shows 'RECONNECTING'); SSE endpoint returns 200 but no data is streamed within 5s despite immediate yield in backend code (likely upstream/ingress buffering).
passed: POST /api/auth/login with invalid SPOC -> 401 with correct error message
POST /api/auth/login with valid SPOC (rajat.bhasin@mongodb.com) -> 200, returns spoc details + sets access_token cookie
GET /api/batches?status=Accepting Nominations -> 200, returns 2 batches (Bangalore, MongoDB for Developers)
Login page renders with 4 form fields (organization_name, customer_name, email, spoc_email)
Successful login redirects to /portal and sets JWT cookie
Portal header displays org name 'Test Corp', user 'John Doe', and email 'john@test.com'
Course catalog left panel shows 4 MongoDB training courses
Clicking course opens slide-over detail panel with course overview / who should attend / key topics
Calendar shows 7-column Sun-Sat grid for current month (June 2026)
Location filter (All Locations) and Track filter (All Tracks) dropdowns present
'Show batches: <track>' links present under each course

failed.issue: Frontend SSE status indicator shows 'RECONNECTING' (yellow) instead of connected (green). curl to /api/sse/batches returns 200 but streams no data within 5s, even though backend yields the first event immediately before sleeping 30s. Likely proxy/ingress buffering despite X-Accel-Buffering: no header.
failed.evidence: Screenshot after_login.png shows 'RECONNECTING' badge in header. `timeout 5 curl -sN /api/sse/batches` produced 0 bytes of body.

failed.issue: Only 2 batches exist in DB, both dated Aug 2026, so on the default current-month view (June 2026) the calendar appears empty. Not a code bug, but UX: user must navigate forward to see batches. Worth seeding more data or auto-jumping to month with nearest batch.
failed.evidence: DB batches: batchNo 81 startDate 2026-08-03, plus 1 more. June 2026 calendar shows no events.

failed.issue: training_name field is empty string '' in API response because the source documents in DB have no trainingName/training_name field; only 'track' is populated.

action_items: Investigate SSE streaming: confirm whether ingress/Kubernetes proxy is buffering text/event-stream. May need to push an initial keepalive comment (':\n\n') and flush, or shorten sleep interval, or ensure response is not gzipped/buffered.
Optional: seed batches in current month for demo, or have UI auto-navigate to the next month containing nominations.
Optional: backfill trainingName in batches collection or derive it from track in the backend response.

test_credentials.source: queried spocDetail collection in MongoDB Atlas (mcp-forge db)
